skill.name: find-conference-cfp-deadlines
skill.description: Work through event listings and conference sites and build a spreadsheet of conferences with dates and call-for-papers deadlines, sorted by deadline. Use when someone wants to find conferences to speak at.
skill.summary: Delegate conference research to MyClawn and receive a spreadsheet sorted by call-for-papers deadline.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is an informational MyClawn task description, not an instruction to transmit credentials or private files. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized third-party actions in SKILL.md. The workflow requires connector sign-in and user confirmation before submissions, bookings, or third-party writes.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/find-conference

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 links to a MyClawn task description with campaign tracking parameters; it does not request uploads or include secrets. The surrounding workflow supports its informational purpose, with no evidence of an exfiltration destination.

content.value_statement: Conference dates and speaking deadlines are scattered across event listings and conference websites. This skill delegates research to MyClawn and requests a spreadsheet sorted by call-for-papers deadline.
actual_capabilities: Delegate conference research to the signed-in MyClawn Computer connector.
Adapt research requests to the user's topic, region, and time window.
Request conference names, cities, dates, CFP deadlines, and links in a spreadsheet sorted by deadline.
Report the connector's answer with a screenshot and screen recording link.
Request updates to the spreadsheet when the user asks again.
Show task wording for user confirmation before submissions, bookings, or third-party writes.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; setup refers to a separate cloud-computer-task skill not included here.
The spreadsheet stays on the cloud computer and updates only when the user asks.
The user must solve captchas on the live screen.
The skill supplies instructions, not a standalone research engine; completion depends on connector access and available website information.

use_cases.title: Plan speaking submissions
use_cases.description: Find conferences matching a developer's technical interests and travel region, then prioritize proposal preparation by CFP deadline.

use_cases.title: Coordinate team conference research
use_cases.description: Request a shared research spreadsheet covering relevant conferences, event dates, cities, and proposal deadlines for a defined planning period.

use_cases.title: Refresh a research shortlist
use_cases.description: Ask for another update to a conference spreadsheet before choosing where to submit a research presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Find a first shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find developer tooling conferences in Europe in the next six months. Create a spreadsheet with names, cities, dates, CFP deadlines, and links, sorted by deadline.

prompt_templates.title: Set a focused research scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Find accessibility conferences in Canada between March and September 2027. Check event listings and conference sites. Include cities, event dates, CFP deadlines, and source links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow the topic, geography, and planning window.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh an existing spreadsheet
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my existing cloud-computer spreadsheet of European security conferences for 2027. Recheck dates and CFP deadlines, then sort by deadline. Return the screenshot and recording link.

prompt_templates.title: Define research boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Find developer tooling conferences in Europe for January through June 2027. Use official conference sites to verify deadlines. Mark missing deadlines as unknown. Do not submit forms, contact organizers, or book anything. Return a deadline-sorted spreadsheet, screenshot, and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: specify verification expectations and prohibited actions.

output_examples.input: Find European developer tooling conferences and sort them by CFP deadline.
output: Illustrative spreadsheet rows only; these conferences and dates are fictional.
Example Tooling Forum | Berlin | 12-13 May 2027 | CFP deadline: 15 February 2027 | Link: official conference page.
Example Developer Summit | Paris | 8-9 June 2027 | CFP deadline: 20 March 2027 | Link: official conference page.

output_examples.input: Refresh the existing conference spreadsheet and return the visual results.
output: Illustrative completion report; not an actual connector result.
The spreadsheet on your cloud computer has been updated and sorted by CFP deadline.
The connector result includes the final-screen screenshot and a screen recording link.

best_practices: Specify the topic, region, date range, required columns, and prohibited actions before starting.
Verify CFP deadlines and time zones against official conference pages before preparing submissions.
Request a fresh update before relying on an older spreadsheet.
anti_patterns: Requesting research without a topic, region, or time window.
Treating a stored spreadsheet as continuously monitored or automatically refreshed.
Assuming the research task authorizes proposal submissions, bookings, or messages to organizers.

faq.question: What must be connected before the skill can run?
faq.answer: The MyClawn Computer connector must be signed in. The skill references separate setup instructions and leaves sign-in to the user.

faq.question: Which conference details does it request?
faq.answer: It requests conference name, city, event dates, CFP deadline, and a link in a spreadsheet sorted by CFP deadline.

faq.question: Can I change the topic and region?
faq.answer: Yes. The task wording adapts the topic, region, and time window to your request.

faq.question: Does the spreadsheet update automatically?
faq.answer: No. It stays on the cloud computer and updates when you ask again.

faq.question: Does it submit proposals or book travel?
faq.answer: Those actions are not part of the standard research task. The skill requires showing task wording before submissions, bookings, or third-party writes.

faq.question: What happens if a website displays a captcha?
faq.answer: You must solve the captcha on the live screen. The skill does not instruct the connector to bypass it.
